input: I don't think it's required to do browser only tools here. i want to abolish that policy have where things run be up to the agent and the project. it's fine to do browser. but having a strict requirement on all project is a bad an unnessary restriction. lets go and get rid of the hard and fast rules for that.

doc_friction.issue: Still required 'Pure JavaScript (or WebAssembly) in the tab; no server' after the 2026-10-21 static-only rule was dropped; the browser-only requirement outlived the static-only one.
§7 'no key, no account' contradicted §3's API-key switch and §2's 'account only if needed'.
